hooks.command: B="${AGENT_BOT_BIN:-agent-bot}"; command -v "$B" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "agent-bot is not installed — install agent-bot-identity" >&2; exit 127; }; exec "$B" claude-worktree-create
hooks.statusMessage: Creating worktree with its bot identity…
